title: 第11章 抓贼第12章 明修栈道暗度陈仓
content_zh:
;;
“终于来了，等你们好久了！”
李向东猛地睁开眼睛盯向池塘边某一处，刚要起身去抓贼。
又担心去得太早打草惊蛇，做不到人赃并获。
目光一瞧趴着的大黄，顿时计上心头，伸手抱过大黄将它横卧在灯旁，并在它耳边小声嘱咐道：
“大黄，有贼来偷鱼，保持这样的姿势别动。”
大黄抬头瞅一眼外面的情况，伸出爪子挥了挥，示意明白。
并且还将耳朵垂下，让它投影在瓜棚上的影子更像是一个睡在被窝里的人。
“干得好，大黄，等抓到贼，我给你吃不带尿骚味的鸡腿！”
“旺。”大黄小声喊一句，用眼神示意快去。
李向东有了大黄的障眼法相助。
悄无声息的溜出瓜棚，运起《长生经》将身体里黄豆那么大的“气”都灌注到脚底。
整个人跑起来身轻如燕，神不知鬼不觉的到了三个偷鱼贼身后潜伏下来。
只听并列站着的偷鱼贼中，最左边一个背着渔网的年轻瘦猴子率先发现瓜棚中的人影。
惊讶道：
“四哥，快看那边瓜棚，今天怎么突然有人守夜，难不成我们偷鱼的事已经被发现了？”
站在三人中间领头的四哥，是个三十左右的汉子，身形精壮。
听着小弟的提醒，他也察觉到异样，眼神中闪过一丝犹豫。
但看着灯下的人影趴着，似乎已经陷入熟睡，一咬牙低沉道：
“不管他，来都来了，反正不能空手而归，撒网！”

眼见有人守夜，他还是要偷鱼，胆子也不可谓不大。
然而站他右边的年轻小胖子则明显有些心虚，杵在那里不动。
犹豫再三小声劝阻道：
“四哥，要不今天算了吧，要是被抓到，咱们不仅吃不了兜着走。”
“还要把这十来天的都吐出来！”
四哥被不吉利的话扫了兴致，反手一巴掌扇在胖小弟头上，低声喝骂道：
“去你吗的会不会说话！你再诅咒老子，老子扇死你！”
“不抓鱼去卖，你他么拿钱给老子去扳本吗？”
小胖子被扇得一脸委屈：“四哥，我没钱......”
四哥瞧着他火大，再次踹他一脚：
“没钱还不干活，老规矩，弄他个一百多斤，卖了一人给你们分一百！”
content_en:
;;
"It's finally here, I've been waiting for you for a long time!"
Li Xiangdong suddenly opened his eyes and stared at a certain place by the pond, just about to get up to catch the thief.
I was also worried that I would go too early to alert the enemy and not be able to capture both the stolen goods and others.
As soon as he glanced at the lying rhubarb, he immediately thought about it. He reached out and hugged the rhubarb, laid it down next to the lamp, and whispered in its ear:
"Dahuang, there are thieves coming to steal the fish, keep this posture and don't move."
Dahuang raised his head to take a look at the situation outside, stretched out his paw and waved to show that he understood.
He also drooped his ears so that the shadow cast on the melon shed was more like a person sleeping in the bed.
"Good job, Dahuang. When the thief is caught, I'll give you chicken legs that don't smell like urine!"
"Wang." Dahuang shouted in a low voice and signaled with his eyes to go quickly.
Li Xiangdong was helped by Dahuang's blinding method.
He quietly slipped out of the melon shed, picked up the "Eternal Life Sutra" and poured all the "qi" in his body as big as a soybean into the soles of his feet.
He ran as light as a swallow and lurked behind the three fish thieves without anyone noticing.
Among the fish thieves standing side by side, a young skinny monkey on the far left carrying a fishing net was the first to notice the figure in the melon shed.
Surprised:
"Fourth brother, look at the melon shed over there. Why is there suddenly someone keeping watch today? Could it be that our stealing fish has been discovered?"
The fourth brother, who was the leader among the three, was a man in his thirties, with a strong build.
After listening to his younger brother's reminder, he also noticed something strange, and a trace of hesitation flashed in his eyes.
But looking at the figure lying under the lamp, seemingly falling into a deep sleep, he gritted his teeth and said in a low voice:
"No matter who he is, he's here anyway. You can't leave empty-handed anyway. Let's cast the net!"
Seeing someone keeping watch at night, he still wanted to steal the fish, and he was quite courageous.
However, the young fat man standing on his right was obviously guilty and remained motionless.
He hesitated and whispered again and again:
"Fourth brother, why don't we just forget about it today? If we are caught, not only will we not be able to eat, but we will have to walk around in circles."
"I have to vomit out all these ten days!"
The fourth brother was turned off by the unlucky words. He slapped the fat boy on the head with his backhand and cursed in a low voice:
"Fuck you for not being able to speak! If you curse me again, I will slap you to death!"
"If you don't catch fish and sell them, how can you give me money to make up for it?"
The little fat man was slapped and looked aggrieved: "Fourth brother, I have no money..."
The fourth brother saw how angry he was and kicked him again:
"If you don't work if you don't have money, the old rule is, make him more than a hundred pounds, sell each one and give you a hundred cents!"
